decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler sits close to the core air-cooling offer and has been on the market only two years, so management still reads modest results as ramp-up and stays committed to it.

With the overlapping Product C already withdrawn, the remaining air cooled condenser carries the firm's visible commitment to this segment and its efficiency direction, so management persists with it.
The multi-model customized air cooler line embodies the firm's announced promise of customized integrated solutions and represents heavy sunk investment, making withdrawal very unlikely.

The tube end repair inserts are inexpensive to maintain and support the lifecycle service commitments the firm publicly makes, although the earlier withdrawal of the related tube liner shows that repair products are not immune to cuts.
